translations.web: I will raise up to them a plantation for renown, and they will no more be consumed with famine in the land, and not bear the shame of the nations any more.
translations.bsb: And I will raise up for them a garden of renown, and they will no longer be victims of famine in the land or bear the scorn of the nations.
translations.kjv: And I will raise up for them a plant of renown, and they shall be no more consumed with hunger in the land, neither bear the shame of the heathen
